items.title: Replace this example item with the project's real backlog.
body: Seeded by houserules init --tracker json. Add sections as `backlog/items/<section>.json` files; keep ids unique across the backlog.

Read the backlog with `houserules list --open`, `get <id>`, `batch <n>`. Add a record for batch <n> to `backlog/batches.json` first; `backlog/schema.json` lists its fields. Then tick items with `set <id> status=done batch=<n>`: `check-backlog` fails for an item whose batch has no record.
